RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

————

Total number of questions — 20
Amendments to Wakf Act
*61. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI : Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any suggestions have been
received for amendments to the Wakf Act,
1995;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action being taken in the matter?
Merger of Mid-Day Meal programme
with S.S.A.
*62. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY :
Will the Minister of  HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have implemented Mid-Day Meal
programme in the schools in various States;
and
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government propose to merge Mid-Day
Meal programme with Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan?
Puppet shows
*63. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA :
Will the Minister of  CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government had held any
puppet shows for the children on the
occasion of the International Puppetry Day
recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount incurred; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to increase the awareness
about the puppet shows among kids?
Elementary education and SSA in NE
States
*64. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to strengthen the feedback gathering system
on the progress of elementary education

20
and Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) in North-
Eastern States;
(b) whether under the existing funding
arrangement for elementary education and
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, the Union and State
Governments, contribution ratio has been
75 and 25 per cent respectively;
(c) whether during the last two years
some degree of stability was brought in NE
States; and
(d) if so, what steps Government
propose to achieve progress of elementary
education and SSA in these States?
Accountability of foreign channel
operators
*65. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Amended Cable TV
Network Rules, 1994 make foreign channel
operators (Discovery, Ten Sports, Star
Network and HBO) more accountable, as
now they will have to register themselves
by depositing Rs. 1.5 crore and also
nominating an Indian for telecasting their
programmes in the country;
(b) if so, whether a special mechanism
has been evolved for this purpose; and
(c) if so, whether the discrepancies, if
any, detected in their programmes would
be taken care of?
Illegal mining
†*66.  SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
  SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of  MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether illegal mining is being carried
out in various parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the financial loss suffered as a result
thereof during the last three years;
(d) the impact of illegal mining activities
on the environment; and
(e) the steps taken/to be taken by
Government to deal with such illegal
activities?
Abolition of quota and reservation in
private institutions
*67. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  the Supreme Court of India
has recently ruled that Government,
requirement that the private institutions
which do not receive any State aid, should
also follow Government's policy on
reservation of seats for the backward
classes, is a serious encroachment on the
rights and autonomy of these institutions;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) Government's reaction thereto and
the steps, if any, proposed in this regard;
(d) whether Government have
constituted any committee for monitoring
the fee-structure in the private institutes;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof ?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

21
Nude serials on Doordarshan
*68. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:  Will
the Minister of  INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rape cases
take place only due to broadcast of "Nude
Serials" on Doordarshan;
(b) if so, the details of such serials;
(c) the steps being taken/proposed to
be taken to put a ban on broadcast of such
serials; and
(d) by when such directions are
expected to be issued?
Foreign universities and educational
institutions
*69. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
cognizance of the foreign universities and
educational institutions coming to India to
attract Indian students;
(b) if so, whether Government have
ascertained their accreditation in the
respective countries;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any norms for such universities
and institutions and whether their degrees
are recognized in the country;
(d) whether such institutions offer
fellowships and other facilities to our
students; and
(e) whether Government have
formulated any advisory for our students
in this regard?
Punishment to rapists
*70. SHRIMATI MOHSINA KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of  LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a  fact that law provides
punishment for the proven guilt of rape "a
minimum of 7 years imprisonment", still
many courts have either awarded lesser
years of imprisonment and High Courts
have even reduced the sentences in such
cases; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
ensure that maximum punishment, as
provided in the law, be awarded in proven
cases to deter the prospective perpetrators
of this heinous crime?
Centres for certificate authentication
*71. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the locations of the centres where
authentication of certificates of educational
qualifications for the persons seeking
employment in Arabian countries is being
done in the country;
(b) whether Government are aware of
the hardships faced by the persons coming
from distant places to New Delhi for this
purpose; and
(c) whether Government would open
more authentication centres in the country
to save the job seekers from the ordeal of
long travel?

22
Obscene programmes on foreign
channels
†*72.  SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a  fact that due to lack
of any effective Government's control on
the foreign channels they are telecasting all
types of fair, unfair as well as obscene
programmes;
(b) if so, what concrete steps
Government is taking in this regard;
(c) whether Government propose to
allow telecasting facility to the registered
channels only through "Cable or Direct to
Home (DTH)'' service;
(d) if so, details thereof; and
(e) the steps Government would initiate
to have control on the unregistered
channels?
Foreign universities
*73. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL:  Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number and name of the foreign
universities operating in the country
through centres/franchises and the courses
they are offering;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
are not able to monitor functioning of the
foreign universities in India  and the
students are largely clueless about quality
of such centres and courses; and
(c) how Government plan to formalize
the present informal arrangements regarding
functioning of the foreign universities
indicating  the details thereof and time frame
therefor?
Publication of Jai Prakash Narayan's
works
*74. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have scuttled publication of Jai Prakash
Narayan's selected works after 1964; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
†*75. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH::
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of the Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan in various States, State-wise;
(b) whether some of the States have not
yet achieved the target; and
(c) if so, the names of those States and
the steps being taken for proper imple-
mentation of this programme?
Amenities for the poor in NER
*76. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
Minister of  URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVER TY ALLEVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any programmes/schemes
have been formulated by Government to
provide amenities to poor living in small
and big cities in the North Eastern Region,
particularly in Assam, during the last two
years; and
(b) the amount sanctioned district/
block-wise by Government during this
period and the amount spent by the State
Governments in this connection?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

23
Uday Shankar Academy in Almora
†*77. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of  Minister of   CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the construction work of Uday
Shankar Academy, which is under
construction in Almora (Uttaranchal), is
pending; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when this academy is likely to be
constructed?
Professionalisation of management
*78. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of  Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PU BLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of heavy industrial
undertakings and public enterprises where
professionalisation of top management has
been introduced as a policy initiative, and
whether the same would percolate down in
the hierarchy;
(b) whether there has been any marked
gain or improvement in performance as a
result of this process and how long it would
take to complete this process in all units of
this sector;
(c) the number of the units already
closed, those in operation and economic
viability of the running units; and
(d) the future prosects of these units,
category-wise?
Participation of children in functions
*79. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
SHRI THENNALA G.
    BALAKRISHNA PILLAI:
Will the Minister of   HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that small school
children are being sent to perform in high
profile birthday functions of past and
present leaders where they have to wait
for hours;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to end this practice and direct the State
Governments not to summon small children
for such functions;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Gandhi Heritage Sites Project
*80. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
has launched Gandhi Heritage Sites Project
to map the milestones of Mahatma Gandhi's
life as has been done in foreign countries;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 22nd November, 2005   Secretary-General.

Construction of a "Ghat" on the bank
of Yamuna
440. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to construct a "Ghat" on the bank of River
Yamuna, on the pattern of "Har Ki Pauri
Ghat" at Hardwar (Uttaranchal) to celebrate
"Chhat Festival" in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when it is expected to be
constructed and other facilities to be
provided for devotees?
Construction of Gurdwara in Puri
441. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a hi-tech
revolving Gurdwara, the first of its kind in
the country, would be constructed near the
sea beach in Puri, Orissa, to mark the visit
of Guru Nanak, the first Guru of Sikhs, to
this holy city in 1506;
(b) whether this Gurdwara has already
started functioning on a temporary basis;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Heritage sites in NER
442. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that nine national
sites in the North Eastern Region (NER)
are proposed to be recommended as World
heritage sites;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are aware that
Orissa is one of the historical heritage
centres of the country which are the most
sought after religious hubs in the World;
(d) if so, whether there is a proposal to
recommend any of such centre as World
heritage; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

102
Remains of cities near Surat
†443. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Archaeo-
logical Survey of India has recently found
one thousand year old remains of cities and
villages near Surat in Gujarat; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Valley of Flowers in Uttaranchal
444. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the World
famous Valley of Flowers in the Uttaranchal
Himalayas has been declared a natural
World heritage site by UNESCO; and
(b) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to conserve this site?
Corporate participation for
conservation of monuments
445. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Archaeological Survey of India, the sole
custodian of the national monuments, has
decided to allow corporate participation in
its conservation efforts;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
initial corporate participation would be for
conservation of 5000 monuments under the
ASI's direct protection; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Munshi Premchand Memorial
Research and Study Centre
446. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up a Munshi Premchand Memorial
Research and Study Centre at his native
village in UP;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
estimated cost thereof;
(c) whether such memorials are
proposed to be set up for the other great
poets and authors of Hindi and regional
languages;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Documentation of unprotected
manuscripts of Karnataka
447. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Karnataka has requested for financial
assistance for documentation of
unprotected manuscripts scattered all over
the State; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Tomb of Bahadur Shah Zafar
448. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
approached the Government of Myanmar
to bring the tomb of the Last Emperor of
India Bahadur Shah Zafar to the country;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

103
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be brought to Delhi; and
(c) the location selected to set up the
Tomb of that Emperor?
Conservation and restoration work of
monuments
449. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the need of hour is conservation and
restoration works of the monuments;
(b) if so, whether Government are
according it any priority;
(c) whether it is a fact that concerned
department has conserved some structures
like Qutub Shahi Tomb in Hyderabad,
Ghanpur Groups of Temple and
Kondapally Fort at Kondapally;
(d) if so, besides above what are the
other monuments/structures of historical
importance which need immediate
conservation/restoration;
(e) whether any allocation has been
made therefor by the concerned State/
Central Government; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Conference on Cultural Bio-Diversity
450. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India has participated in
the recent UNESCO conference on Cultural
Bio-Diversity;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
have not forcefully forwarded the views to
preserve Cultural Bio-Diversity;
(c) the steps Government would take
to raise the issue of Cultural Bio-Diversity
at all international fora;
(d) whether any Task Force has been
formed by Government to work on this
matter; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Protected monuments under ASI
451. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI: Will the Minister of
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the protected
monuments under ASI in Uttar Pradesh and
Bihar, city-wise and town-wise;
(b) the expenditure incurred during the
last two years for their preservation and
maintenance, monument-wise;
(c) the amounts earmarked for their
preservation during the current year,
monument-wise; and
(d) the requests and complaints received
in respect of the monuments of the above
States?
Development and propagation of
Indian Culture
452. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether theatre has traditionally
played a very significant role in
development and propagation of Indian
Culture;
(b) the steps taken for the growth of
traditional Indian Folk Theatres; and
(c) whether there is a plan to revive and
bring these theatre on the pattern of modern
day city life of the country?

104
Development of heritage sites
453. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the heritage sites
developed during the year 2004-05 by the
National Culture Fund along with funds
allocated therefor;
(b) the details of the heritage sites
proposed to be developed during the year
2005-06 through foreign assistance
particularly in Tamil Nadu; and
(c) the funds received by Government
from foreign countries and international
agencies for the development of these sites?
Kannada as classical language
454. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Sanskrit has been accorded
the status of classical language;
(b) if so, whether Government are aware
that Kannada language has the history of
1600 years;
(c) whether the State Government has
requested to accord classical language status
to Kannada language; and
(d) if so, the status of the above
proposal?
Sale of surplus land of sick PSEs
†455. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to sell
surplus land of the sick Public Sector
Enterprises under his Ministry to improve
their condition;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) Government's policy regarding sale
of surplus land and the estimated amount
to be received as a result thereof industry-
wise;
(d) whether Government have prepared
any action plan to improve condition of
the Public Sector Enterprises by the money
so earned;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, by when an action plan would
be prepared?
Revival of PSUs
456. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has proposed
to the Ministry of Finance and Planning
Commission that revival of sick PSUs as
per recommendation of Board for
Reconstruction of Public Sector Enterprises
(BRPSE) could be made partly from
budgetary funds and rest by loans from the
commercial banks;
(b) whether BRPSE has earlier
considered and recommended 15 PSEs for
revival;
(c) if so, whether the Cabinet has already
approved the proposals of his Ministry;
(d) by when Government are likely to
revive these 15 PSUs; and
(e) whether PSU revival would cost
Government of Rs. 9000 crores during the
current financial year?

Government directors on boards of
PSEs
457. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the guidelines for Government
directors on the board of directors of the
PSEs;
(b) whether Government have fixed any
eligibility criterion of requisite academic and
professional qualifications for holding such
position;
(c) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor and whether Government
propose to fix such criterion for
Government directors;
(d) whether their presence undermines
autonomy of the PSEs; and
(e) the manner in which Government
assess performance of Government
directors on the Boards of PSEs?
Generation of extra budgetary
resources by PSEs
458. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES  be pleased to state:
(a) the measures being adopted by the
PSEs to generate extra budgetary resources;
(b) whether in this respect, the BRPSE
has recommended certain measures to
unlock the surplus assets of the PSEs, if
so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government would also
consider listing the PSEs in stock markets;
and
(d) to what extent such measures would
ease reliance of PSEs on budgetary support
from Government?
Revival of HMT, Kalamassery
459. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal of a
revival package for the Hindustan Machine
Tool Ltd. Kalamassery, Kerala;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government thereon?
Identification and revival of sick PSUs
460. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of  HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES  be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the undertakings which
are under BIFR;
(b) the details of the loss making
undertakings and the undertakings under
BIFR which are taken up for revival
package, the progress made so far and by
when the process would be over and the
undertakings be revived; and
(c) whether there is any move to
privatise or disinvest any of the profit
making undertakings in deviation of the
common minimum programme?
Differences over education cess
461. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
Group of Ministers to resolve differences

106
over the use of the money collected as
education cess;
(b) if so, the composition thereof;
(c) whether the GoM had met and
discussed in this regard recently;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the outcome thereof?
Linking of schools through EDUSAT
462. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
pilot project of his Ministry, 1,000 schools
in Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh
and Uttar Pradesh will be linked through
EDUSAT, the exclusive education satellite;
and
(b) if so, the details of the project and
the estimated cost thereof?
Universalisation of secondary
education
463. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI C. PERUMAL:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Rs. 81,000
crore detailed programme has been drawn
up for universalising secondary education
on the pattern of the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the funding of the programme and
the role assigned to the States and its present
status;
(d) the details of any dedicated
machinery proposed to be set up for
successful implementation of the gigantic
programme; and
(e) the Planning Commission reaction
thereto?
Exploitation of young women by NRIs
464. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether numerous instances of
exploitation of young women in the pretext
of marriage by NRIs have come to
Government's notice;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures being contemplated to
prevent such instances in the future?
Utilization of Education Cess
465. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the 2 per
cent education cess has yielded Rs. 5,010
crore and it is likely to touch Rs. 10,000
crore in 2005-06 but his Ministry has no
idea where the money is parked;
(b) whether it is a fact that this money
is funding key components of elementary
education the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)
and the ten year old Mid-Day Meal Scheme
(MDMS); and
(c) if so, the amount spent on these two
schemes so far and how Government
propose to spend the remaining amount?

107
Recognition to Business Schools
466. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
